activity_summary: You came home from the rehearsal and did not go out for Richard II. You took the soft side of a penny loaf that was still a full thumb short of the notch. You said the hole has closed and the jaw is still tender, and you did not call yourself well. You did not name the man who plays the king this afternoon. Mistress Ansell does not go to a playhouse, and you did not bring her one.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Called the jaw tender, refused a name for the king, and kept to the one word he had written.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Set the soft side, refused a play at her board, and kept the noon candle unlit.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Measured the loaf, offered broth, and carried the crusts off the board.
